catalogue.description: Whether the session's chain run says what the options are: its fetch succeeded, or it did not list the instrument (no options)

catalogue.name: feature.option_tier
catalogue.description: The worse of the put and call tier (option_liquidity); D: no usable options, also for an instrument the session's chain run did not list
catalogue.nullMeaning: option_chain_known is not true (no chain run for the session, or its fetch failed: STALE_DATA, FETCH_ERROR, NOT_ATTEMPTED)

catalogue.name: feature.option_chain_oi
catalogue.description: Chain open interest (option_liquidity); 0 when the chain run did not list the instrument
catalogue.nullMeaning: option_chain_known is not true

catalogue.name: feature.option_chain_volume
catalogue.description: Chain volume (option_liquidity); 0 when the chain run did not list the instrument
catalogue.nullMeaning: option_chain_known is not true

catalogue.name: feature.liquidity_high
catalogue.description: Every HIGH threshold holds: 20-session ADV >= $100M, close >= $10, worse option tier A, chain OI >= 50k, chain volume >= 5k (params; a threshold <= 0 is no requirement)
catalogue.nullMeaning: no threshold fails and one cannot be checked (an unknown ADV, close or option input)

catalogue.name: feature.liquidity_medium
catalogue.description: Every MEDIUM threshold holds: 20-session ADV >= $10M, close >= $5, worse option tier A or B, chain OI >= 5k (params; chain volume 0: no requirement)
catalogue.nullMeaning: no threshold fails and one cannot be checked (an unknown ADV, close or option input)

catalogue.name: feature.liquidity_class
catalogue.description: HIGH when every HIGH threshold holds, else MEDIUM when every MEDIUM one does, else LOW; UNKNOWN when an unknown input decides it
catalogue.nullMeaning: no price_stats row for the instrument on the session (no bar)

catalogue.name: feature.pct_from_high_52w
catalogue.description: Close / 52-week high - 1 (at or below 0)
catalogue.nullMeaning: price_stats high_52w is null (fewer than 240 bars in the last 252 sessions), or no price_stats row

catalogue.name: feature.pct_from_low_52w
catalogue.description: Close / 52-week low - 1 (at or above 0)
catalogue.nullMeaning: price_stats low_52w is null (fewer than 240 bars in the last 252 sessions), or no price_stats row

catalogue.name: feature.near_52w
catalogue.description: Where the close sits in its 52-week range: HIGH within 10% (params.within) of the high, LOW within 10% of the low, BOTH (a narrow range), else NONE
catalogue.nullMeaning: the 52-week high or low is unknown (pct_from_high_52w or pct_from_low_52w is null)

catalogue.name: feature.iv_hv_spread
catalogue.description: IV30 minus HV30 (iv_history, price_stats): the variance risk premium's raw input
catalogue.nullMeaning: iv30 or hv30 is null (no IV for the session, or a gap in the last 31 sessions)

catalogue.name: feature.iv_hv_ratio
catalogue.description: IV30 / HV30 (iv_history, price_stats)
catalogue.nullMeaning: iv30 or hv30 is null, or hv30 is 0
